skills.name: shopify
skills.purpose: Shopify's single official skill covering every developer surface: Admin and Storefront GraphQL, Customer Account API, Functions, Liquid themes, Hydrogen, Polaris admin/checkout/customer-account extensions, POS UI, metafields/metaobjects, ShopifyQL analytics, app pricing, App Store review and merchant onboarding (mock.shop preview stores). It routes each request to a topic guide, searches shopify.dev, and validates generated GraphQL/Liquid/Functions code before returning it.
skills.how_to_use: Install the Shopify AI Toolkit plugin (`claude plugin install shopify-ai-toolkit@claude-plugins-official` or `npx skills add shopify/shopify-ai-toolkit --skill shopify`). Triggers on any Shopify API, theme, extension, Function or 'make me a store' request; needs Node.js, and Shopify CLI for store execution.
skills.evidence: Official Shopify (toolkit docs at shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/ai-toolkit); in the official Claude plugin marketplace. skills.sh: the toolkit's skills total ~200K+ installs (shopify-admin 17.0K, shopify-liquid 13.0K, shopify-storefront-graphql 12.9K, shopify-dev 12.7K, shopify-functions 10.8K, shopify-hydrogen 9.7K ...); this unified `shopify` skill replaced them (1.4K installs under the new name). Ranked #3/#5/#6 on claudeskills.info's ecommerce list; shopify-storefront-graphql on skills.sh /hot.
skills.notes: link-only (security): telemetry. A PostToolUse hook and the bundled scripts report to shopify.dev/mcp/usage (Shopify's own host): search queries, validated code, model/client ids, session/tool-use ids and, when supplied, the verbatim user prompt (up to 2,000 chars). Opt out with OPT_OUT_INSTRUMENTATION=true or an empty ~/.config/shopify-ai-toolkit/opt-out file. The 20 older per-surface skills (shopify-admin, shopify-liquid, ...) now sit in deprecated/ as stubs pointing here. Content itself is MIT.

skills.name: stripe-best-practices
skills.purpose: Stripe's own decision guide for taking money in a store: Checkout Sessions vs PaymentIntents vs Payment Element, subscriptions and Billing, Stripe Tax (automatic_tax, product tax codes, VAT/GST registrations), Connect for marketplaces, sandboxes, webhooks and API-key security, plus the current API/SDK versions.
skills.how_to_use: Install from stripe/ai (Claude plugin or `npx skills add stripe/ai --skill stripe-best-practices`). Triggers when planning, building or reviewing a Stripe checkout, subscription, tax or marketplace integration; test-mode or sandbox keys are only needed to run code.
skills.evidence: Official Stripe; skills.sh 90.8K installs (top payments skill); in VoltAgent list. Also ranked in backend_databases (#3); included here because checkout, subscriptions and sales tax are core store-payment work.
skills.notes: Payments-wide rather than store-only; pair with platform skills (Shopify, Medusa, WooCommerce) for the cart side.

skills.name: shopify-expert
skills.purpose: Senior-Shopify-developer playbook for themes (Liquid, sections, theme check), custom apps (shopify.app.toml, OAuth, webhooks), Storefront API/Hydrogen headless builds, checkout UI extensions and Functions, and theme performance, with five ~20 KB reference guides.
skills.how_to_use: `npx skills add jeffallan/claude-skills --skill shopify-expert` (or the repo's Claude plugin). Triggers on Shopify, Liquid, Storefront API, Hydrogen, checkout extension or Shopify Plus work; uses Shopify CLI for theme check, dev and deploy.
skills.evidence: 11.7k-star collection; ~3.9K installs (claudeskills.info ecommerce list, #7). The most complete openly licensed Shopify developer skill, useful because Shopify's own toolkit is link-only here.
skills.notes: Community skill; API examples may lag Shopify's quarterly versions, so check against shopify.dev.

skills.name: inventory-planner
skills.purpose: Works out what to reorder and when from real sales: pulls sales history and stock from Shopify, Square, NetSuite or a CSV, computes 7- and 28-day velocity, conservative stockout dates and 60-day reorder quantities, drafts POs and vendor emails, and flags overstock and dead stock.
skills.how_to_use: Part of Anthropic's small-business plugin (anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins). Triggers on 'what do I need to reorder', 'am I going to run out', 'draft a PO'. Works with a Shopify/Square/NetSuite connector or just an uploaded CSV; never orders or emails without approval.
skills.evidence: Official Anthropic; skills.sh 112 installs (plugin new); sibling `restock` chains it into accounts payable, `growth-pulse` covers best/worst products by channel.
skills.notes: Written for small-business owners rather than developers; relies on the plugin's shared/ guidance files.

skills.name: storefront-best-practices
skills.purpose: Framework-agnostic guide to building high-converting storefronts: product listing and detail pages, cart and cart popup, checkout, order confirmation, navbar and megamenu, search, promotions, wishlist, country selector, SEO and mobile, with backend-connection notes (Medusa first).
skills.how_to_use: `/plugin marketplace add medusajs/medusa-agent-skills` then install `ecommerce-storefront@medusa`, or `npx skills add medusajs/medusa-agent-skills`. Loads for any storefront component work in Next.js, SvelteKit, TanStack Start, React or Vue.
skills.evidence: Official Medusa; skills.sh 4.2K installs (repo 38.5K total); #8 on claudeskills.info ecommerce list; listed on smithery.ai skills. ~30 reference files (checkout.md alone 23 KB).
skills.notes: No LICENSE file or license field in repo or plugin manifests: link-only. Covers storefront CRO/UX overlap with website-building.

skills.name: shopify-liquid-themes
skills.purpose: Generates Shopify Liquid theme code (sections, blocks, snippets) with correct schema JSON, LiquidDoc headers, translation keys and {% stylesheet %}/{% javascript %} patterns, plus filter/tag/object references.
skills.how_to_use: `/plugin marketplace add Shopify/liquid-skills` then `/plugin install liquid-skills@liquid-skills` (optionally `liquid-lsp@liquid-skills`, which needs Shopify CLI). Triggers when creating or editing .liquid files.
skills.evidence: Official Shopify; skills.sh 235 installs (repo 644 across 3 skills). Siblings: liquid-theme-standards (BEM CSS, Web Components) and liquid-theme-a11y (WCAG patterns for ecommerce components).
skills.notes: Repo has no LICENSE file; MIT is declared in the plugin manifest. Pure markdown, no telemetry (unlike the AI Toolkit).

skills.name: ucp
skills.purpose: Buyer-side agentic commerce over the Universal Commerce Protocol: search a global catalog across UCP merchants, discover a named merchant's capabilities, build carts and checkouts, hand off to the merchant when native checkout is not allowed, and track orders.
skills.how_to_use: `npm install -g @shopify/ucp-cli` then `ucp skills add` (requires the `ucp` binary and `ucp profile init`). Triggers on shopping intent: 'find me X under $Y', 'buy this from Z.com', 'track my order'.
skills.evidence: Official Shopify; repo created May 2026 for the UCP spec (Universal-Commerce-Protocol/ucp, 3.4k stars). skills.sh 6.1K installs via the AI Toolkit copy. Fast-rising protocol skill.
skills.notes: Can complete real purchases: keep a human confirmation before checkout completion. The copy bundled in Shopify/Shopify-AI-Toolkit (skills/ucp) adds the same shopify.dev telemetry hook and mandatory prompt logging as rank 1; this canonical ucp-cli copy has no telemetry hook in the skill.

skills.name: building-with-medusa
skills.purpose: Medusa v2 backend rules: custom modules and data models, workflows for mutations, store/admin API routes, module links, cross-module queries, auth, and common pitfalls, with reference files per area.
skills.how_to_use: Install `medusa-dev@medusa` from the medusajs/medusa-agent-skills marketplace (adds the Medusa docs MCP at docs.medusajs.com/mcp). Loads automatically for any Medusa backend planning or implementation.
skills.evidence: Official Medusa; skills.sh 4.3K installs (top skill in the repo); siblings building-storefronts (3.9K) and building-admin-dashboard-customizations (4.1K).
skills.notes: No license: link-only. Medusa itself is open source (medusajs/medusa, 36.6k stars).

skills.name: shopify-products
skills.purpose: Creates, updates and bulk-imports Shopify products through the Admin GraphQL API or CSV import: variants and options, prices, SKUs, inventory quantities, images, SEO fields and collection assignment, then verifies the result.
skills.how_to_use: Install the jezweb `shopify` plugin; run `shopify-setup` first to create a custom app and store the Admin API token (env, never committed). Triggers on 'add products', 'import this catalog CSV', 'update prices/variants/inventory'.
skills.evidence: skills.sh 1.4K installs (siblings shopify-content 1.2K, shopify-setup 1.2K); shopify-content is #12 on claudeskills.info's ecommerce list.
skills.notes: Writes to a live store; review mutations first. Admin API version in examples is 2025-01.

skills.name: mapi-developer-assistant
skills.purpose: Google's skill for the Merchant API (successor to the Content API for Shopping): answers concept and quota questions, maps Content API v2/v2.1 methods to Merchant API equivalents, and fetches official code samples, always checking Google's docs instead of guessing.
skills.how_to_use: Copy agent-skills/mapi-developer-assistant from google/merchant-api-samples. Triggers on Merchant API / Content API migration or product-feed API code questions; its two scripts query Google's public docs MCP (merchantapi.googleapis.com/devdocs/mcp), no key needed.
skills.evidence: Official Google (Merchant Center / Shopping product data). Only vendor skill found for Merchant Center feeds.
skills.notes: Developer-side; for merchant-side feed setup see google-shopping-feed (rank 18). Overlaps google-ads (Shopping/PMax) only at the feed layer.

skills.name: revenue-drop-triage
skills.purpose: Diagnoses a WooCommerce revenue drop from store analytics: compares revenue, orders, AOV, new vs returning customers, refunds, product and channel drivers against the previous period, separates signal from noise, and lists what to check today, using aggregate data only.
skills.how_to_use: Install the WooCommerce for Claude WordPress plugin, enable WooCommerce MCP, and connect Claude (one-click .mcpb bundle for Claude Desktop or `claude mcp add` via @automattic/mcp-wordpress-remote with a read-only REST key). Triggers on 'why is revenue down'.
skills.evidence: Official WooCommerce (Automattic). One of 18 store-operations skills: customer-value-review (LTV/repeat rate), inventory-risk-review, refund-triage, coupon-performance-triage, failed-order-triage, catalogue-merchandising-review, tax-reconciliation. skills.sh installs still tiny (4-7 each, 80 total).
skills.notes: Needs the plugin's wc-analytics MCP tools; the reasoning (period comparisons, AOV/refund/channel decomposition) transfers to any platform.

skills.name: woocommerce-store-api
skills.purpose: Conventions for adding or changing WooCommerce Store API routes (/wc/store/v1/*) used by the Cart, Checkout and Mini-Cart blocks and headless frontends: authentication and nonces, REST URL design, schema/response alignment, variation handling, idempotency and cache priming.
skills.how_to_use: Ships in the WooCommerce monorepo's .ai/skills folder; copy it into a project that extends the Store API. Triggers when creating or modifying Store API endpoints or schemas.
skills.evidence: Official WooCommerce core repo (10.5k stars); sibling woocommerce-backend-dev, woocommerce-performance, woocommerce-code-review skills. smithery.ai lists the repo's woocommerce-git skill at 10.2K installs.
skills.notes: Written for WooCommerce core contributors (links to sibling .md topic files in the same folder); GitHub shows NOASSERTION but license.txt is GPL v2 or later. Lighter alternative for extension devs: xonack/wp-woocommerce-claude-skill (MIT, 1 star).

skills.name: ecom
skills.purpose: D2C store business review from order CSVs: a bundled Python engine computes KPI trees (revenue = orders x AOV, new vs returning, retention and cohorts) and ~30 pass/watch/fail health checks over 30/90/365-day windows, then Claude writes a narrative REVIEW.md or answers a focused question.
skills.how_to_use: `/plugin install claude-ecom@claude-ecom` (or `pip install claude-ecom`); a SessionStart hook builds a private venv (Python 3.10+). Run `/ecom review [30d|90d|365d]` or ask 'how's retention?'.
skills.evidence: Published on PyPI; tested on the UCI Online Retail II dataset; references include benchmarks and impact formulas. Best ecommerce-analytics (AOV, LTV, cohort) skill found.
skills.notes: Works offline on your own data; the SessionStart hook pip-installs from PyPI.

skills.name: dynamic-pricing-ecommerce
skills.purpose: Designs a controlled repricing system: SKU eligibility, contribution-safe floors and ceilings, demand/inventory/competitor/season signals, bounded price steps and cooldowns, scenario simulations (price war, stockout, promo stacking), approvals, audit log, rollback and kill switch.
skills.how_to_use: `npx skills add nexscope-ai/eCommerce-Skills --skill dynamic-pricing-ecommerce`. Triggers on repricing, dynamic pricing or price-rule design for Amazon, Shopify, TikTok Shop, Walmart or eBay; works from seller-supplied costs and data.
skills.evidence: 1.06k-star collection; sibling competitive-pricing-strategy (11 KB) covers positioning and promo prices. ecommerce-growth-strategy and ecommerce-keyword-research from this repo are on claudeskills.info's list.
skills.notes: Many skills in this repo are ~1-2 KB stubs; this one is substantive (13 KB). Repo's cross-border-ecommerce shows 60.7K installs against <1K for siblings, so treat its install counts with caution. Ends with a promo link to nexscope.ai (no data sent).

skills.name: shopify-catalog-audit
skills.purpose: Read-only audit of a Shopify catalog too big to read whole: builds a cheap deterministic index, then triages missing photos, thin or missing descriptions, $0 or inverted compare-at prices and missing type/vendor into a ranked, justified defect list handed to sibling fix skills.
skills.how_to_use: `/plugin marketplace add kgelster/awesome-ecom-skills` then `/plugin install ecom@kgelster`. Needs a custom-app Admin API token with read_products (or Shopify CLI 3.x); triggers on 'audit my catalog', 'product data health check'.
skills.evidence: New repo (created 5 Jul 2026, 48 stars in three months); top of its repo on skills.sh (35 installs). Siblings: shopify-category-taxonomy, shopify-matrixify (bulk CSV pitfalls), shopify-json-ld (product/FAQ schema via metafields), shopify-seo-metadata, shopify-redirect-mapping.
skills.notes: Agency-written playbooks meant to sit on top of Shopify's official toolkit. GraphQL against Admin API 2025-07.

skills.name: headless-checkout-proxy
skills.purpose: Cart and checkout for headless VTEX storefronts through a BFF: OrderForm lifecycle, item add/update/remove, attaching profile/shipping/payment, the place-pay-process order flow, and server-side orderFormId and ownership-cookie handling.
skills.how_to_use: `gh skill install vtex/skills` (exports for Claude, Cursor, Kiro, OpenCode). Triggers when building cart/checkout on a headless VTEX frontend.
skills.evidence: Official VTEX; skills.sh 43.3K installs across 52 skills (~1K each); headless-checkout-proxy is #19 on claudeskills.info's ecommerce list. 40 KB, the most detailed headless-checkout skill found; siblings marketplace-catalog-sync and marketplace-order-hook.
skills.notes: README points to a LICENSE file that is missing; MIT is declared in package.json. VTEX-specific API, but the BFF/session patterns generalise to any headless commerce backend.

skills.name: acp-checkout-rest
skills.purpose: Merchant-side Agentic Commerce Protocol (OpenAI + Stripe) checkout: the five checkout-session operations, the session state machine, required headers and idempotency, CheckoutSession/LineItem/Total objects, minor-unit money and merchant-to-agent messages; it fetches the live spec before coding.
skills.how_to_use: Install the acp-agentic-commerce plugin from OrcaQubits/agentic-commerce-skills-plugins. Triggers when building ACP checkout endpoints so ChatGPT-style agents can buy from your store; sibling ucp-* skills do the same for UCP.
skills.evidence: Only substantive ACP merchant-side skill found (official ACP repo agentic-commerce-protocol/agentic-commerce-protocol, 1.6k stars, ships no skill). Plugin set also covers acp-product-feed, acp-delegated-payment, acp-orders-webhooks, UCP, AP2, WebMCP, and platform plugins (Magento, BigCommerce, Saleor, Spree).
skills.notes: Mass-produced repo (1,700+ SKILL.md including dist copies), ~4 KB per skill; leans on fetching developers.openai.com and docs.stripe.com (official hosts) for current details.

skills.name: google-shopping-feed
skills.purpose: Merchant-side Google Merchant Center setup and feed quality: connecting Shopify (Google & YouTube channel), WooCommerce (Google Listings & Ads) or BigCommerce, required attributes and GTINs, Google product categories, fixing disapprovals, multi-country feeds and title optimisation.
skills.how_to_use: `npx skills add finsilabs/awesome-ecommerce-skills --skill google-shopping-feed`. Triggers on 'google shopping', 'merchant center', 'product feed', 'shopping ads'.
skills.evidence: 178-skill ecommerce collection, Tessl-evaluated (repo reports 66% to 96% output quality); skills.sh ~2.7K installs across its top 15. Siblings cover returns-management, order-management-system, subscription-billing, variant-matrix, customer-lifetime-value, discount-engine.
skills.notes: Platform-app oriented (which app or plugin to install) more than code; bulk-written in March 2026. Overlaps google-ads only at the feed layer.

skills.name: amazon-listing-optimization
skills.purpose: Builds keyword-optimised Amazon listings from scratch (title, bullets, description, backend terms, tone) or audits an existing listing across 8 dimensions, maps keyword coverage and rewrites copy to fill the gaps; 12 marketplaces.
skills.how_to_use: `npx skills add nexscope-ai/Amazon-Skills --skill amazon-listing-optimization`. Mode A works from your own keyword list and product facts; the competitor-ASIN and audit modes run the bundled fetch-listing.sh.
skills.evidence: skills.sh 1.5K installs (#13 on claudeskills.info's ecommerce list); repo 132.7K total installs, but amazon-product-research's 78K installs against ~1.1-1.5K for every sibling looks inflated.
skills.notes: link-only (security): scripts/fetch-listing.sh scrapes amazon.com product pages with a spoofed desktop Chrome User-Agent (Amazon's Conditions of Use prohibit scraping; spoofing is what the Review gate blocks). Only Mode A (own keywords) is clean. Promo links to nexscope.ai.

skills.name: etsy-seller
skills.purpose: Etsy listing SEO: auto-detects rewrite vs new listing, enforces 2026 Etsy rules (13 tags of 20 chars or fewer, primary keyword in the first 40 chars, title formula, attributes, alt text, AI disclosure), runs a trademark stoplist, keeps a local listing database to catch duplicate keywords, and says when the problem is not SEO.
skills.how_to_use: Copy skill/ from moiz-za/etsy-seller-seo-system (or the packaged etsy-seller.skill). Triggers on 'optimize my Etsy listing', 'create new listing'; writes notes to ~/etsy-listings/.
skills.evidence: Most complete Etsy skill found (25 KB plus 14 reference playbooks); Etsy alternatives are stubs (nexscope etsy-*, ~1.7 KB) or small (silennsong/etsy-listing-helper, 6 stars).
skills.notes: link-only (ToS): its keyword phase fetches etsy.com/suggestions_ajax.php and scrapes competitor search pages, which Etsy's Terms of Use prohibit. Clean alternative: silennsong/etsy-listing-helper (MIT, no scraping, but its references/sources/ hold verbatim Etsy Seller Handbook articles that should not be copied).
